description: This file implements the 'FetcherConfig' class and related functions for managing configuration data, including reading/writing JSON files, handling CVD file entries, and converting between JSON and internal representations.

classes.name: FetcherConfig
classes.description: Class responsible for managing fetcher configuration, including loading/saving JSON data, managing CVD files, and recording flags.

classes.name: CvdFile
classes.description: Represents a CVD file with source, build ID, build target, and file path.

methods.name: SourceStringToEnum
methods.description: Converts a string to a FileSource enum value.

methods.name: SourceEnumToString
methods.description: Converts a FileSource enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: operator<<
methods.description: Outputs a CvdFile object to an ostream.

methods.name: FetcherConfig::SaveToFile
methods.description: Saves the current configuration to a specified file.

methods.name: FetcherConfig::LoadFromFile
methods.description: Loads configuration data from a specified file.

methods.name: FetcherConfig::RecordFlags
methods.description: Records current command-line flags into the configuration JSON.

methods.name: JsonToCvdFile
methods.description: Converts a JSON value to a CvdFile object.

methods.name: CvdFileToJson
methods.description: Converts a CvdFile object to a JSON value.

methods.name: FetcherConfig::add_cvd_file
methods.description: Adds a CvdFile entry to the configuration JSON.

methods.name: FetcherConfig::get_cvd_files
methods.description: Retrieves all CvdFile entries from the configuration.

methods.name: FetcherConfig::FindCvdFileWithSuffix
methods.description: Finds a CVD file with a specific suffix.

methods.name: FetcherConfig::AddFilesToConfig
methods.description: Adds multiple files to the configuration with specified purpose, build info, and paths.
